stem: Show 3 daily routine cards: waking up, eating breakfast, sleeping. Child puts them in sequence.
Show numeral 5 beside 3 groups of objects. Child circles the group with 5 objects.
Teacher asks child to recite numbers 1 to 20 aloud without objects. Record fluency.
Show two groups of objects (3 and 4 items). Child determines total count without plus symbol.
Teacher hands child a ball and asks for physical description in child's own words.
Show a box where all objects have been removed. Child writes the numeral representing empty set.
